# Official interoperability fixtures

The interoperability suite uses two immutable, independently produced
artifacts instead of archives generated by this library:

- Unity Technologies' `Unity-PostProcessing-1.0.4.unitypackage` exercises the
  legacy archive reader against 233 real Unity-exported records, explicit GUID
  directory entries, and previews.
- VRChat's `com.vrchat.core.vpm-resolver-0.1.9.zip` exercises UPM/VPM package
  conversion against an artifact published in VRChat's official VPM listing.

The binaries are not copied into this repository. Their original URLs, exact
sizes, and SHA-256 digests are pinned in `manifest.json`; CI downloads and
verifies them with the repository's Go fixture fetcher:

```sh
go run ./internal/cmd/fetchtestdata -dir /tmp/unitypackage-testdata
```

The fetcher stores immutable blobs by digest outside the repository, safely
extracts ZIP fixtures, and writes an `index.json` consumed by
`internal/interop`. This preserves provenance and avoids silently repacking a
fixture with the implementation under test.

Malformed and adversarial archives are still generated in unit tests because
no official package should contain those cases.
